name: 25 SL MkII (ReMOTE SL MkII)
category: 25-key controller keyboard with encoders, pots, pads
notes: Works driverless as USB-MIDI. The Novation driver adds multi-client use and Port 2. Port 1 carries Advanced-mode template MIDI; Port 2 is Automap/host. Use Advanced mode (not Automap) for these tests so controls send their template MIDI. The template's CC and note numbers are user-configurable, so tests learn them live. Some range-wide specs (sliders, 32 buttons) belong to the 49/61 models; this database assumes no faders on the 25.

drivers.name: Novation USB Driver 2.30.0.83 (optional; class driver also works)
Automap 4.12 (discontinued; not needed for MIDI tests)

manuals.title: SL MkII MIDI Programmer's Reference (community upload)

serviceManual.notes: Not public. Use Focusrite/Novation authorised service; schematic archives (none confirmed) or donor parts.

setup: Connect USB (or 9 V DC as well). Exit Automap, then select a factory Advanced-mode template.
Select the 'SL MkII (Port 1)' input ('2- SL MkII' with the class driver).
failureModes: Touch-sense false triggers or dead touch on encoders/pots
Uneven key velocity, dead keys (dirty contacts)

tests.name: Ports & template mode
steps: Port 1 and Port 2 (driver) or the class-driver port should be visible. Write the names in the notes.
The LCD should show an Advanced-mode template name, not Automap.

tests.name: Any MIDI arrives
steps: Play a key.

tests.name: All 25 keys
steps: Play every key from lowest to highest, one at a time, and release each.
Gaps mean dead keys. Double-triggers or held notes mean dirty contacts.

tests.name: Velocity response
steps: Play several keys very softly, then very hard. The full spread should be reachable.

tests.name: Channel aftertouch
steps: Hold a key and press into the keybed. Channel pressure should rise to 100 or more and fall back to 0.

tests.name: Octave / transpose buttons
steps: Press octave up, then play a key: the note number shown in the Monitor should rise by 12. Repeat for down and transpose.

tests.name: Pitch bend
steps: Push the pitch control fully up and down, letting it spring back to centre 3 times.
The rest value must return to centre (offset near 0).

tests.name: Modulation
steps: Move the mod wheel/control slowly from minimum to maximum.

tests.name: X/Y touchpad
steps: Slide a finger to all four edges of the XY pad, so X and Y each reach their minimum and maximum.

tests.name: Sustain, expression, footswitch inputs
steps: Plug in the sustain pedal and press/release it. Then connect expression (sweep) and footswitch if available.
Lower the count in your notes if you don't have both pedals.

tests.name: 8 endless encoders
steps: Turn each encoder 4+ steps each way. The LED ring should follow.

tests.name: 8 absolute pots full travel
steps: Turn each pot slowly fully left, then fully right. Each must hit 0 and 127 without jumps.

tests.name: Touch sensing on encoders/pots
steps: If touch-sense is enabled in the template, touch and release a few encoders and pots without turning them.
False triggers from touching nothing = fault. Skip this test if touch-sense is off.

tests.name: 8 drum pads
steps: Hit each pad and release. A note left held after release = a hanging-note fault.

tests.name: Pad velocity range
steps: Hit every pad soft and hard.

tests.name: Transport ×6 (Rew, FF, Stop, Play, Loop, Rec)
steps: Press each transport button.

tests.name: Row / select buttons
steps: Press each row button next to the encoders and pots. Adjust the count in your notes to your template.

tests.name: Button LED feedback (echo)
steps: Select 'SL MkII (Port 1)' as the device out and press Send. Note which LEDs light. LED rings need the Automap/Programmer's Reference commands, so 'no response' is a finding.

tests.name: LCD (2×72 chars)
steps: Check the backlight, contrast and that every character cell renders while scrolling templates.

tests.name: MIDI Out → MIDI In loopback
steps: Connect a 5-pin cable from MIDI OUT 1 to MIDI IN. Route the computer → MIDI Out port (see manual: Port 2/Out routing) and run.
Repeat with OUT 2 and note the result.
